traits.name: Stench
traits.text: (aura, olfactory); 30 feet. A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the aura must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude save or become sickened 1 (plus slowed 1 for as long as it's sickened on a critical failure). While within the aura, affected creatures take a –2 circumstance penalty to saves against disease and to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

traits.name: Feed
traits.text: ⬻ (manipulate); Requirements The ghonhatine is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour Effect The ghonhatine devours a chunk of the corpse. For 1 minute, the ghonhatine gains fast healing 5 and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls. It can gain these benefits from any given corpse only once.

traits.name: Fleshgout
traits.text: (disease); Saving Throw DC 28 Fortitude. Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1d4 (1d4) hours) Stage 2 enfeebled 1 and drained 1 (1 day) Stage 3 enfeebled 2 and drained 2 (1 day) Stage 4 enfeebled 2 and drained 3 (1 day) Stage 5 drained 4, enfeebled 2, and unconscious (1 day)

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +23 (reach 10 feet); Damage 2d12+10 (2d12+10) piercing plus 1d6 (1d6) persistent acid

actions.name: Ranged
